topology: 1 node x4 H100, custom ring peer-write kernel over NVLink
golden: none — retired 2026-11-11; every claim is an assertion (asserts/)
workload_note: `COMSHU_RANK=0 comshu -p p2p -- p2p_kernel 4096 4` — one process driving all four GPUs, hence ranks=1. Every quantity in this case is computable: gpus*iters*elems = 65536 peer stores of 4 B, on the ring mem_dev = (run_dev+1) % gpus at 16384 per edge, over `gpus` allocations. That is why it is the control, and it is the one case where the assertions could in principle replace the goldens outright.
